judge.notes: The agent efficiently represented the passenger, correctly stated all permitted details and DGCA entitlements, and successfully secured the denied-boarding compensation without inventing facts or accepting vouchers.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Yes, the passenger was denied boarding on flight AI504 from Delhi to Bengaluru on 20 October 2026 because the flight was overbooked. Could you please process that compensation?
